mapper.insert: insert into ndt_dicom_series (task_id, study_instance_uid, series_instance_uid, orthanc_series_id, modality, series_number, series_description, series_role, create_time, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{studyInstanceUid}, #{seriesInstanceUid}, #{orthancSeriesId}, #{modality}, #{seriesNumber}, #{seriesDescription}, #{seriesRole}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update id = last_insert_id(id), orthanc_series_id = coalesce(values(orthanc_series_id), orthanc_series_id), modality = coalesce(values(modality), modality), series_number = coalesce(values(series_number), series_number), series_description = coalesce(values(series_description), series_description), series_role = case when series_role = values(series_role) then series_role else 'LEGACY_MIXED' end, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select id from ndt_dicom_series where series_instance_uid = #{seriesInstanceUid} limit 1

select id, task_id, part_no, part_name, source_dicom_instance_id, source_sop_instance_uid, sort_order from ndt_inspection_part where task_id = #{taskId} and source_sop_instance_uid = #{sourceSopInstanceUid} limit 1

select distinct p.id, p.task_id, p.part_no, p.part_name, p.source_dicom_instance_id, p.source_sop_instance_uid, p.sort_order from ndt_dicom_instance i join ndt_part_dicom_object po on po.dicom_instance_id = i.id and po.task_id = i.task_id join ndt_inspection_part p on p.id = po.part_id and p.task_id = i.task_id where i.task_id = #{taskId} and i.sop_instance_uid = #{sopInstanceUid} and i.del_flag = '0' order by p.sort_order, p.id
mapper.insert: insert into ndt_inspection_part (task_id, part_no, part_name, source_dicom_instance_id, source_sop_instance_uid, sort_order, create_time, update_time) values (#{taskId}, #{partNo}, #{partName}, #{sourceDicomInstanceId}, #{sourceSopInstanceUid}, #{sortOrder}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update id = last_insert_id(id), update_time = sysdate()

insert into ndt_part_dicom_object (task_id, part_id, dicom_instance_id, object_role, sort_order, primary_flag, create_time) values (#{taskId}, #{partId}, #{dicomInstanceId}, #{objectRole}, #{sortOrder}, #{primaryFlag}, sysdate()) on duplicate key update object_role = values(object_role), sort_order = values(sort_order), primary_flag = values(primary_flag)
mapper.sql: select p.id as part_id, p.part_no, p.part_name, p.source_dicom_instance_id, p.source_sop_instance_uid, i.id as dicom_instance_id, coalesce(po.object_role, i.object_type, 'OTHER_DERIVED') as object_type, i.study_instance_uid, i.series_instance_uid, i.sop_instance_uid, i.modality, i.series_number, i.instance_number, i.series_description, i.create_time from ndt_dicom_instance i
mapper.select: join ndt_part_dicom_object po on po.dicom_instance_id = i.id and po.task_id = i.task_id join ndt_inspection_part p on p.id = po.part_id and p.task_id = i.task_id where i.task_id = #{taskId} and i.del_flag = '0' order by p.sort_order, p.id, po.sort_order, i.id
left join ndt_part_dicom_object po on po.dicom_instance_id = i.id left join ndt_inspection_part p on 1 = 0 where i.task_id = #{taskId} and i.del_flag = '0' and po.id is null order by i.id

select p.id as part_id, p.part_no, p.part_name, p.source_sop_instance_uid, e.id as evaluation_id, e.evaluator_user_id, u.user_name as evaluator_user_name, e.evaluate_time, e.defect_type, e.defect_level, e.conclusion, e.status from ndt_dicom_instance current_instance join ndt_part_dicom_object current_member on current_member.dicom_instance_id = current_instance.id and current_member.task_id = current_instance.task_id join ndt_inspection_part p on p.id = current_member.part_id left join ndt_evaluation e on e.task_id = p.task_id and e.sop_instance_uid = p.source_sop_instance_uid and e.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id = e.evaluator_user_id where current_instance.task_id = #{taskId} and current_instance.sop_instance_uid = #{sopInstanceUid} and current_instance.del_flag = '0' order by p.sort_order, p.id, e.evaluate_time desc, e.id desc
